title: File:乱云飞渡-高原的朝霞 dawn, Tengchong - panoramio.jpg
claims: A dawn view over Tengchong town: dark tiled roofs and low buildings in the foreground, the edge of the urban area and wooded hills under a grey-pink sky; no lake, park gate, start arch or runners are visible. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file 乱云飞渡-高原的朝霞 dawn, Tengchong - panoramio.jpg. The route page uses it as Tengchong town context near the Yanhu Park start of MGU; it does not show Yanhu Park, the start line or race-day conditions.

The Commons author field reads wanghongliu; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/); the relevant date is 2010-09-18 (Commons upload date); the file page gives a camera or subject position of 25.038086 N, 98.488108 E; the original is 3,532 × 1,921 px; 1,019,035 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 522 px; 89,086 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits wanghongliu, CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
